property_summary: For every caller address X, calling assertionDisputedCallback from X on the correct contract never succeeds when X is not the optimisticAsserter (only the optimisticAsserter is allowed); the mutant inverts this check so some non-optimisticAsserter callers that should be rejected will succeed (or vice versa), causing differing observable success/failure for some caller addresses.
change_summary: Change onlyOptimisticAsserter modifier to require the caller is NOT the optimistic asserter (invert check), altering which callers can enter assertionResolvedCallback and thus observable behavior.
